findings.title: README still says new output returns a scrolled terminal to the bottom (contradicts FR-18 / D315)
findings.evidence: README.md:335-336: '...scroll back (10 000 lines, setting `scrollback`); any key or new output returns to the bottom.' Since FR-18, commands/terminal.rs refresh() no longer resets tab.scroll on output (doc comment l.806-808: 'Output leaves a scrolled-back view where it is'); only term keys (handle_key -> scroll_to_bottom), paste() and type_line() return to the bottom (D315). A user reading the README expects the view to jump on output, which is exactly the behaviour FR-18 removed.
findings.fix_suggestion: Replace with: 'a key typed into the program, a paste or a typed line returns to the bottom; new output leaves a scrolled view where it is (the ↑ indicator shows how far back you are).'

findings.title: docs/keymap.md Terminal row still says 'any key or new output returns to the bottom' (contradicts FR-18 / D315)
findings.evidence: docs/keymap.md:214: 'shift+pageup/shift+pagedown scroll back (main screen only; any key or new output returns to the bottom)'. Same stale rule as README.md:336; the code since FR-18 keeps the scrolled view while output streams (commands/terminal.rs refresh(), refresh_holds_view).
findings.fix_suggestion: Change the parenthesis to '(main screen only; a key sent to the program or a paste returns to the bottom; new output keeps the view)'.

findings.title: dark theme explorer kind colours fall under the 3:1 selection floor used for the colour themes
findings.evidence: Theme::dark selection bg is Indexed(239) (#4e4e4e). On it, CodeNative Indexed(203) #ff5f5f ~2.8:1, Generated Indexed(246) #949494 ~2.8:1, Media LightMagenta (xterm #ff00ff ~2.7:1, VTE Tango #ad7fa8 ~2.6:1). explorer.rs:62 keeps the kind colour on the unfocused cursor row and on multi-selected rows. dracula/synthwave are fitted to 3:1 on the selection (explorer::fitted floors) and contrast.md lists only those two; the test explorer_kinds_of_dark_and_light_read_on_common_terminal_backgrounds checks only the plain background, not selection. Light theme passes (~3.0-3.9).
findings.fix_suggestion: Pick dark-theme indices that keep >=3:1 on #4e4e4e (e.g. 210 #ff8787 for CodeNative, 248 #a8a8a8 for Generated, 213 #ff87ff for Media) and extend the dark/light test to assert >=3.0 against the selection bg (Indexed 239 / 153).

findings.title: README says dotfiles are dimmed and italic, but dot config files and dot folders are not
findings.evidence: README.md:86-88 '... lock/generated; dotfiles dimmed and italic'. ui/explorer.rs kind_of: .gitignore/.gitattributes/.editorconfig/.dockerignore -> Config, '.eslintrc.json' -> Config (by extension), dot folders (.github, .vscode) -> Folder; only dotfiles without a known kind become Hidden.
findings.fix_suggestion: Say 'other dotfiles dimmed and italic' (or 'dotfiles without a known type').
